Description: Ask {BOT_NAME} a question and receive an AI generated response.
LLM_Context: The 'ask' command sends a user's question to an AI server and returns a natural language response generated by {BOT_NAME}.

Description: Displays a list of all available commands with descriptions and examples.
LLM_Context: The 'commands' command provides a summary of all bot commands to help users understand available features.

Description: Displays a list of all economy commands
LLM_Context: The 'economycommands' command provides a summary of all econmy commands to help users understand available features.

Description: Displays a list of all game commands
LLM_Context: The 'gamecommands' command provides a summary of all game commands to help users understand available features.

Description: Displays a list of commands only server moderators can use.
LLM_Context: Displays a list of commands only server moderators can use.

Description: Displays your _(or another server members)_ profile. Include Level, XP, {CURRENCY_NAME}, Game Streaks, and Owned Items.
LLM_Context: Displays the players _(or another server members)_ profile. Include Level, XP, {CURRENCY_NAME}, Game Streaks, and Owned Items..

Description: Displays top 10 users by level and XP. _(also displays {CURRENCY_NAME} amount)
LLM_Context: Shows a leaderboard of the top 10 members sorted by level and XP, including their {CURRENCY_NAME} balance.

Description: Manually award {CURRENCY_NAME} to a user as compensation.
LLM_Context: Grants {CURRENCY_NAME} to a user for errors/outages.

Description: Give another member some of your {CURRENCY_NAME}.
Example: {COMMAND_PREFIX}give `AMOUNT` `@USER` `OPTIONAL_REASON` | `{COMMAND_PREFIX}give 100 @{BOT_NAME} I see you could use some {CURRENCY_SYMBOL}!`
LLM_Context: Transfers {CURRENCY_NAME} from one user to another with an optional reason included in the embed.

Description: Starts a bet with another member on the server for the specified amount.
LLM_Context: Allows members to challenge each other to a bet, with acceptance, resolution, and lockout on disagreements.

Description: Displays the profile cosmetics shop with available items.
LLM_Context: Shows items available for purchase, plus how to preview, buy, and equip cosmetics.

Description: Preview an item before buying it.
LLM_Context: Displays a preview embed for a cosmetic. Frames show the PNG preview image; colors show a generated color swatch and tinted embed.

Description: Buy an item from the shop.
LLM_Context: Purchases a frame (by ID) or a color (by name) if the user has enough currency, then adds it to their owned cosmetics.

Description: Equip an owned cosmetic, or unequip with 'none'.
LLM_Context: Equips an owned item to the user's profile or unequips using 'none'.

Description: Displays your _(or another user's)_ owned cosmetics and what is currently equipped.
LLM_Context: Shows equipped items for the specified user.

Description: Starts a Wordle game.
LLM_Context: Begins a Wordle game session; use `{COMMAND_PREFIX}guess` to submit guesses.

Description: Submit a guess in your active Wordle game.
LLM_Context: Adds a guess to your active Wordle game; up to 6 guesses per game.

Description: Shows the top 10 members with the highest Wordle streak.
LLM_Context: Displays the top 10 members based on current Wordle streaks.

Description: Starts a Connect 4 game with another member.
LLM_Context: Initiates a two-player Connect 4 match with the tagged user.

Description: Shows the top 10 members with the highest Connect 4 streak.
LLM_Context: Displays the top 10 members based on current Connect 4 streaks.

Description: Starts a Battleship game with another member.
LLM_Context: Begins a Battleship match against the tagged server member.

Description: Shoot at a coordinate in your active Battleship game.
LLM_Context: Fires on the given coordinate in an ongoing Battleship game.

Description: Shows the top 10 members with the highest Battleship streak.
LLM_Context: Displays the top 10 members based on current Battleship streaks.
